claim: A subagent CAN spawn its own subagent on 2.1.219; the changelog's depth-3 default matches observed behaviour, the subagents reference page saying nesting is off does not
method: A general-purpose subagent was dispatched with instructions to spawn an inner agent synchronously via the Agent tool and report the result. The inner agent ran and returned with no error.
reproduction: In a Claude Code session, dispatch a general-purpose subagent whose prompt instructs it to use the Agent tool to spawn an inner general-purpose agent with a trivial task, then report whether the inner result arrived. Success means nesting is on for depth 2.
caveat: The ceiling above depth 2 is unmeasured. Two official sources still disagree; re-verify per build.
